findings.evidence: refunded-mobile.png clips the long Stripe webhook event ID at the right edge.
findings.reproduction: Return from Stripe with a session_id and view the refunded state at mobile width.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply overflow-wrap:anywhere or word-break:break-word to result dd values.

findings.evidence: candidate-tablet.png compresses the ledger text column to a very narrow vertical column beside the action buttons.
findings.reproduction: View the Cobros panel at tablet width around 768px.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a single-column ledger layout below a wider breakpoint, placing actions beneath the ledger copy.

findings.evidence: refunded screenshots show Checkout disabled after returning with session_id, with no visible way to start a new Stripe test session.
findings.reproduction: Complete or refund a hosted Checkout session, then try to run another test from the returned page.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide a visible “Nuevo checkout” action that clears the session state or reloads without session_id.

untested: No browser was launched independently; this is an artifact review of supplied Chromium screenshots plus allowed source.
Keyboard-only traversal and focus states were not separately captured.
Local approved-payment refund execution and repeat-refund interaction were not represented in the supplied screenshots.
No external network, server, or production environment was used.
